content: DST pattern (FoundationDB docs + TigerBeetle + awesome-dst list): whole cluster in one process; virtual time advances only when all simulated components block; seeded RNG drives scheduling and fault injection for perfect replay; faults injected at network/machine/dc level (BUGGIFY). Go tooling is thin: testing/synctest (stable Go 1.25, go.dev/blog/testing-time) gives virtual-time bubbles with deterministic scheduling but no real I/O in bubble; Polar Signals used WASM+runtime mods. Practical Go recipe: inject Transport/Clock/Dumper ports, single-threaded stepwise event loop with seeded scheduler.
